name: Western Swordfern
desc: Western Swordfern (Polystichum munitum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 207 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Polystichum munitum, the western swordfern, is an evergreen perennial fern native to western North America, where it is one of the most abundant ferns in forested areas.
